text: E ko woori Diina kan ka O Suɓanii jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen (Lislaamu on) woni ko ɓee yaltuɓe e ɗoftaare Alla nden ɗaɓɓata?! Hino woodani Mo jebbilaare kala tagu wongu ka kammuuli e ka leydi, e ɗoftaare -wano muumini en- maa waawneede -wano heeferɓe ɓen-, refti ko faade ka Makko Kaŋko Alla woni ruttorde tagu ngun denndaangal; Ñalnde Darngal fii hasbeede ñaawee.
